text:
eva_sales: Quick thread 1: prospect 'CapitolPay' wants enterprise commit guidance. They expect mixed chat+embedding traffic, peak ~520 qps, chat avg 48 tokens, p95 tokens ~240. They asked if 10 reserved GPUs + burst to 20 + KV preheat is reasonable and want KMS + audit answers for questionnaire.
sam_ops: Short take: 10 reserved could be OK with strong KV cache and batching, otherwise underprovisioned for p95 at peak. Recommend reserve=10, max_pool=20, burst_policy=credit, az_strategy=2-way. Need warmup to avoid cold-KV tails.
mina_ml: Throughput rule of thumb: long-tail workloads (~240 tokens) give ~3 RPS/GPU at p95; short requests much higher. If we can get 50-65% KV hit on prefixes, effective footprint drops dramatically. Plan: preheat top 8k prefixes, session-affinity to boost cache locality.
li_security: For questionnaire: we support customer-managed KMS, can export inference metadata (request id, model version, timestamp) to their SIEM, and offer VPC/private control plane for Private deployments. Private/KMS integration lead time ~6-8 weeks.
ops_bot: POC checklist: schedule 90m smoke test. Preheat 30m before. Load profile: 10m baseline, 20m ramp, 20m peak at 520 qps, 20m soak, 20m cool-down. Include embeddings at 20% request mix.
sam_ops: Config snippet (ops):
```
reserved_gpus: "10"
autoscale_min: "10"
autoscale_max: "20"
max_burst_gpus: "10"
preheat_kv: "true"
warmup_targets: "top_8k"
az: "2-way"
fallback_variant: "13b-quant"
```
eva_sales: Pricing ask: please produce two quotes: option A: 10 reserved + burst; option B: 14 reserved + smaller burst. Provide estimated monthly effective per-token after commit discount and warmup token overhead.
sam_ops: Will run quick cost sketch by EOD tomorrow. Expect reserved->14 reduces burst spend ~25% in typical peaks.
mina_ml: I'll produce a 1-page note on expected p95 improvement from KV warmup (include assumptions: kv_hit 50-70%, avg seq 48, p95 seq 240).
li_security: I'll prepare short answers for KMS/audit and timeline notes.
eva_sales: Great, assign tasks and I'll coordinate with CapitolPay to pick a POC date once we have cost sketches. Thanks all.
